full_judgment:
Farah Mahbub J : In this application, filed under section 439 read with section 435of the Code of Criminal Procedure, the opposite parties have been called upon to show cause as to why the impugned order dated 30-1-2018 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Kurigram in Sessions Case No. 87 of 2007arising out of Roumari Police Station Case No. 14 dated 27-10- 2006corresponding to GR No. 108 of 2006 under sections 143/323/324/307/302/114 and 34 of the Penal Code, now pending before the court of learned Additional Sessions Judge, Kurigram, to be set aside. 

 4. From order dated 10-7-2017 it appears that the evidence of the prosecution had been closed by the trial court on 17-8-2015 fixing 31-8-2015 for examination of the accused petitioners under section 342 of the Code. On 31-8-2015 all the 13 (thirteen) accused persons, the petitioners, being present before the court concern they were examined under section 342 of the Code. Since they were not willing to give defence witness the trial court fixed 22-9-2015 for argument. At this juncture, on 22-9-2015 the accused petitioners made a prayer under section 540 of the Code to re-call PWs 10, 11, 13 and 14, which was ultimately rejected by the trial court on the same date. Challenging the said order the petitioners moved the High Court Division of the Supreme Court of Bangladesh by filing Criminal Revision No. 1435 of 2016 which was summarily rejected. Being aggrieved they moved the Appellate Division by filing Criminal Petition for Leave to Appeal No.746 of 2016 which was subsequently dismissed for default. Accordingly, the trial court fixed 30-5-2017 for argument, which was subsequently shifted to 10-7-2017. On the said date the petitioners filed an application under section 340(3) of the Code for recording evidence of the petitioners. Said prayer was turned down by the trial court on the same date i.e., 10-7-2017 for having made the said prayer 2 (two) years after the date so fixed for argument.
